title: Affine-local cohomology of derived pullback
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and $E\in D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $U\subset X$ and $V\subset Y$ be affine opens with $f(U)\subset V$. For each $n\in\mathbb Z$, the restriction to $U$ of $H^n(Lf^*E)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] is quasi-coherent.

source.place: Tag 08DW, perfect-lemma-quasi-coherence-pullback, proof of (1) using (2), and Tag 06Z0

proof.text: Restrict E to V using the reverse implication of schemeDerivedQCoh_openRestriction_iff and Mathlib isQuasicoherent_over in every degree.

Choose standard derived categories on U,V and on Spec Γ(U,O_U), as well as the module derived category. Apply the affine module model to f.resLE V U and the restricted E. Its output is derived exact restriction of the tilde complex of extendScalars of a K-flat input complex.

Apply exists_affineQCohDerivedEquivalence_core on the target ring B=Γ(U,O_U). Its tilde comparison identifies Q(tilde(M)) with the image of Q(M) in the full quasi-coherent derived subcategory, so all its homology sheaves are quasi-coherent.

For exact restriction R along U→Spec(B), compose mapDerivedCategoryFactors, homologyFunctorFactors and mapHomologicalComplexHomologyIso to identify H^i(R(Q(tilde(M)))) with R(H^i(Q(tilde(M)))). Underived restriction preserves quasi-coherence. Transfer it through the affine model isomorphism.

Apply derivedPullback_openRestriction_iso_universes and map its component at E through homology. Transfer quasi-coherence back through that isomorphism, then apply the forward implication of schemeDerivedQCoh_openRestriction_iff to obtain the over-category conclusion in degree n.
